answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in velvet, thus the distribution is public, and jade lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a walnut header, so 295 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
